yourself, you stranger!!

something embarrassing

Four Generals, of course!

there's no guarantee that shady skeleton

call me by my name!!
Even Pikapika would do at this point...

tell us just the gist...

Why'd you go and twitch
the name like that!?

Sorry, I'm tired of talking... ah well,
I'll hurry and teach you just the gist...

poisonous miasma as this land—

the Dark Flu — will
spread across the entire
Element Continent and cover it all...!!

Then every human will fall
to an incurable disease...
This is way worse than I thought!!

Against a disease... there's
no guarding, no escaping!!

We Four Generals have
decided to crown a king...

Yes, just like you —
we'll build a Dark Kingdom
Dark Element Power... in itself, it's vast—
an overwhelming energy of mighty nature...

We Four Generals are, so
to speak, nothing more

than Dark Crystals born from
the Dark Element Power...

mere byproducts that happened
to gain personalities.

The Four Generals alone...
couldn't stop the Dark Element
from being driven out of the world......

That's why we decided to
give the Dark Element Power
The power governing vast, mighty nature!!

When that power itself
gains a personality...

it becomes a king ruling
all by its own will...
The Great Demon King is born!!
This is all so huge I can't even follow...

Turn this whole land into one
where humans can't live...

and build a Dark Kingdom
ruled by some Demon King...
So that's what it is, Pikipiki!!

Bwahahaha!! You're so angry
the veins are popping out,
...Huh, is that my name just now...?

But to create the Demon King —
to give the Dark Elemental Power
a personality... requires a vessel with
a strong spirit... a vessel, right?

In other words, the Four
Generals had to offer themselves!

beings who can exert will
Gah! I-I can't take it anymore...

itself a personality

and make it a Demon King, the Four
Generals, with their strong personalities,

must serve as the substitute
— or rather, the body...

In other words, you lot
not showing your faces

in our lands lately is
because you were preparing

to become the Demon King...
that's it, isn't it, Pikopiko!

For your quick understanding,
I'll forgive the name-teasing—

it's too much hassle anyway,
fine, you're forgiven!!!!
I won't let you do that — !

If you're in a hurry to
become the Demon King,

You, the strongest of the Four
Generals — the final boss —
why are you buying time here?
...Don't you need to become the Demon King?

become the Demon King...

entrusting the future to
the other Generals...!

dream come true himself,
as long as it comes true!!
